name: white petrolatum + zinc oxide
purpose: Uses to prevent diaper rash, chapped skin, and for skin exposed to prolonged moisture Temporarily protects minor cuts, sscrapes and burns. For use on denuded skin associated with exposure to feces or urine
uses: Directions Change wet soiled diapers promptly Cleanse the diaper area and allow to dry apply crean liberally as often as necessary with each diaper change, especially at bedtime or anytime when exposure to wet diapers may be prolonged
